title: Efficacy of hormone therapy and phytoestrogens on the psychological symptoms of menopausal women: a systematic review, meta-analysis, and trial sequential analysis.

answer.design_quote: The inclusion criteria were limited to randomized controlled trials (RCTs) published up to March 1, 2026. Hedge's g was utilized as the standardized between-group effect size, and a random-effects model was applied.
answer.k_quote: We analyzed the participant data from 51 RCTs of hormone therapy ( n = 41,821) and 16 RCTs of phytoestrogens ( n = 1,191).
